Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
Is this our first time here？ I'm actually getting kind of excited.
Yeah. Looks like it'll be fun.
Kobayakawa
What should we play today？
Just don't get too carried away.
Kobayakawa
Here we are again. Hehe... I wanna play a whole bunch today, too.
Yeah. Let's have as much fun as we can.
Kobayakawa
So you didn't get your fill last time either, huh？
To tell the truth, yeah.
Kobayakawa
Come on, let's play till we drop.
Okay.
Kobayakawa
Not 30 was so much fun. Let's play it again sometime.
Yeah, go ahead.
Kobayakawa
Isn't there some kind of guaranteed way to win at Not 30？
Yeah, I think there are certain numbers you want to call out first.
Kobayakawa
Red Light, Green Light is still pretty fun even at our age, huh.
Seriously, that surprised me.
Kobayakawa
You can really see someone's personality in Red Light, Green Light—whether they charge ahead or hang back.
Oh, yeah, I totally get that.
Kobayakawa
Man, that was fun. I might actually be better at giving directions than you.
You might be right.
Kobayakawa
Watermelons are technically vegetables, right...？ Not that I care either way, as long as they taste good.
Haha, now that you mention it, that's true.
Kobayakawa
Catching marshmallows was harder than I thought. That just made me get more into it, though.
Let's do it again sometime.
Kobayakawa
Apparently there are all kinds of ways to eat marshmallows. Plus they have collagen, so they're supposed to be good for your skin.
Eh？ Is that so？
Kobayakawa
Darts really takes concentration, huh. I feel like the better you get, the more addictive it is!
Yeah. Maybe I should practice more, too.
Kobayakawa
There are all kinds of rules for darts, right？ It's probably more fun when you actually know them all.
First we'd have to learn how to keep score. Sounds like a lot of work, though...
Kobayakawa
It's so easy to get super competitive playing Speed. We both had such desperate looks on our faces.
Hahaha, that just shows how fun it is.
Kobayakawa
Speed has house rules too, doesn't it？ It's confusing, so I wish they'd just standardize them.
Yeah, that happens with a lot of other games, too.
Kobayakawa
Why is blowing bubbles so relaxing？
Kids and adults are the same when it comes to stuff like this.
Kobayakawa
They say if you put sugar or hyaluronic acid in bubble solution, the bubbles don't pop as easily.
Hyaluronic acid, huh...
Kobayakawa
This looks so easy on TV, but it's actually pretty hard when you try it yourself.
It keeps you on the edge of your seat the whole time. Really gets the blood pumping.
Kobayakawa
Apparently some famous person came up with this game. Did you know that？
Huh... Is that right.
Kobayakawa
This game is so simple, so why do I get this worked up over it？
It's a really well-made game.
Kobayakawa
When a couple plays this, doesn't it look like they're just flirting？
Yeah... maybe.
Kobayakawa
Space Agent, huh... That was fun. I'll have to remember that one.
Me too!
Kobayakawa
Doesn't a game like this feel like an arcade staple？
Yeah, maybe. It's not something you can easily play at home.
Kobayakawa
I let my guard down thinking you just pick panels. It actually takes a lot of thought.
You probably need both intuition and calculation.
Kobayakawa
When you link the panels together just right, it kind of makes you want to pump your fist.
Yeah, you can't help getting really into it.
Kobayakawa
When it comes down to two choices... it's hard to decide.
Yeah, that's where you really have to use your head.
Kobayakawa
Aw, come on... And we finally had a shot at the jackpot, too.
That's frustrating. Let's try again next time.
Kobayakawa
The moment you hit the jackpot feels amazing, doesn't it？ I could get hooked on this.
I was on the edge of my seat. It felt like it took forever to stop spinning.
Kobayakawa
Grand Cross was fun, wasn't it？ Don't you feel like there's some kind of trick to it？
You seem like you'd be good at figuring that stuff out, ▲小早川＊▲.
Kobayakawa
I didn't think my heart would race like that during the Jackpot Chance.
Seriously. Still stings that we missed it, though.
Kobayakawa
The Grand Cross jackpot was amazing! It felt like a real celebration, I got so excited.
Yeah, I could experience that over and over again.
Kobayakawa
That was fun. Doesn't Fortune Trinity kind of make you feel like you're on a little trip？
Yeah, since you get to see all kinds of World Heritage sites.
Kobayakawa
I really thought we had that jackpot for sure!
That really had our palms sweating, huh.
Kobayakawa
The Fortune Trinity jackpot is pretty great. I like how the medals dispense in time with the music.
Makes you want to see it again.
Kobayakawa
The Anima in Anima Lotta are cute, aren't they？ I think I like the cat-like one best.
The cat-like one... Which one was that again？
Kobayakawa
I really thought we'd get the Jackpot Chance in Anima Lotta. There were so many balls, too.
The light show was really pretty, though.
Kobayakawa
I'm glad we got the jackpot in Anima Lotta. The presentation was really pretty, too. I'm satisfied.
Alright, let's get it again sometime.
Kobayakawa
You really tense up during a Jackpot Chance, huh.
Even when you miss, it's fun just watching the show.
Kobayakawa
I really wanted to win that Jackpot Chance... What a shame.
I'm sure we'll get it next time.
Kobayakawa
Did you see the exact moment we won the jackpot？ I was so happy, I feel like I'm gonna dream about it.
Me too! It's burned right into my memory.
Kobayakawa
Hitting the jackpot makes you wanna brag to everyone out loud, huh.
Yeah. That was honestly kind of moving.
Kobayakawa
Medal games really have that true arcade feel. I think I like 'em.
I had a pretty good time with them, too.
Kobayakawa
Medal games are actually pretty fun. Fighting games are great and all, but I could get hooked on these, too.
Looks like we're gonna end up spending even more time at the arcade.
Kobayakawa
That was a huge haul. We got tons of medals, and the flashy effects were great to watch.
Sure wish it went like that every time.
Kobayakawa
We didn't win that many medals, but the game itself was fun, huh.
Yeah. If we'd won a ton of medals too, I'd have zero complaints.
Kobayakawa
That was seriously fun. I had a blast, anyway. What about you？
Of course I had fun, too.
Kobayakawa
Man, I got way too into that. Was I the only one getting all excited？
Not at all. I got really into it, too.
Kobayakawa
Time really flies, doesn't it. I hate that it's already over.
Seriously. I wish we could keep playing, too.
Kobayakawa
That was the best. I had so much fun I could practically live here. Heheh.
It was definitely worth coming.
Kobayakawa
Man, that was fun. I bet it's only this much fun 'cause I'm with you.
Haha, you sure know how to make a guy happy.
Kobayakawa
I think I'm getting addicted. We definitely have to come back.
Yeah.
Kobayakawa
Hey, when are we coming back？ Make it as soon as possible, okay.
Yeah, sure.
Kobayakawa
Still... that was kinda frustrating. Next time, we're getting payback for sure!
You're really fired up, huh.
Kobayakawa
Still, personally, I can't just accept a result like that.
Just try not to get too carried away, okay.
Kobayakawa
Still, if I'd just pushed a little harder back there... I'm gonna read up on it when I get home.
...You're surprisingly studious about this stuff.
All right, time for the scratch card.
Silver, huh. I'd really like to hit a winner here.
Oh! It's a Gold Scratch—every card's a winner.
Whoa, Platinum! Let's go for the big prize.
This is... the legendary Premier!? It looks almost divine.
Kobayakawa
Isn't it the right one？
Kobayakawa
I have a feeling it's the left one...
Kobayakawa
Hmm, I've got a hunch about the middle one.
Kobayakawa
Umm... It's hard to choose.
Kobayakawa
Ugh, I don't know. I'm leaving it to you!
Kobayakawa
I believe in you!
All right! We got it!
Whoa! Glad I listened to you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Yes! Guess ▲小早川＊▲'s feelings got through.
Aw... Missed it.
I should've trusted your hunch, ▲小早川＊▲...
